messages:
Alex (DevEx): Repro: pnpm workspace + examples/edge-starter fails on Vercel dev with: "Package subpath './edge' is not defined by "exports" in /workspace/packages/js-sdk/package.json". Steps: pnpm i, cd examples/edge-starter, pnpm dev, import { Client } from 'js-sdk' -> build resolves error during rollup/esbuild.

Maya: Sounds like a missing ./edge export and no top-level "types" so TS doesn't find declarations when package is hoisted. Quick workaround: npm pack + install tarball or create a tiny shim package that re-exports dist/index.mjs for demos.

Chris: Action items on SDK: add explicit ./edge export pointing at dist/edge/index.mjs, add "module" and "browser" fields, and set "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" at package root so hoisted TS consumers resolve typings. I'll open a PR for the package.json patch.

Alex (DevEx): Related runtime note: on Edge we saw 401 -> client.refreshToken() start -> fetch retry triggers another request -> second refresh starts -> 401 loop. Repro logs attached to the issue.

Chris: Plan for auth: implement single-flight refresh (share an in-flight refresh promise) and ensure retries either wait for refresh or don't trigger refresh while in-flight. Add a unit test that simulates two overlapping retries.

CI Bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/534 and branch fix/edge-dx-534
